actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own OpenAI action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your OpenAI connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: analyse_document
actions.title: Analyse text
actions.description: Analyse text to answer user-provided questions using OpenAI
actions.help: This action performs a contextual analysis of a text to answer user-provided questions. If the answer isn't found in the text, the datapill will be empty.

input.name: text
input.label: Source text
input.hint: Provide the text to be analysed.

input.name: question
input.label: Instruction
input.hint: Enter analysis instructions, such as an analysis technique or question to be answered.

input.name: model
input.label: Model
input.hint: Select the desired model from the picklist. If left blank, defaults to gpt-4o .

input.name: temperature
input.label: Temperature
input.hint: Enter a value between 0 and 2 for controlling the randomness of chat completions. Higher values will make the output more random, while lower values will make it more focused and deterministic. If lef…

actions.name: analyse_image
actions.title: Analyse image
actions.description: Analyse image to answer user-provided questions using OpenAI
actions.help: This action analyses an image to answer user-provided questions. If the answer isn't found, the datapill will be empty. Supports file size upto 20 MB. Supported formats: png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, pdf . PDF file must be not more than 15 pages.

input.name: file_contents
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Provide the file content to be analysed.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: Provide the file name with file extension or specify the type in File type .

input.name: file_type
input.label: File type
input.hint: Select the file type of the file contents. Overrides the inferred type from File name .

input.name: question
input.label: Instruction
input.hint: Enter analysis instructions, such as an analysis technique or question to be answered.

actions.name: categorise_text
actions.title: Categorize text
actions.description: Classify text based on user-defined categories using OpenAI .
actions.help: This action chooses one of the categories that best fits the input text. The output datapill will contain the value of the best match category or error if not found. If you want to have an option for none, please configure it explicitly.

input.name: text
input.label: Source text
input.hint: Provide the text to be categorized

input.name: category_type
input.label: Category type
input.hint: Enter the type of category to be used. E.g. Sentiment, Emotion, etc.

input.name: object_schema
input.label: List of categories
input.hint: Create a list of categories to sort the text into. Descriptions are used to provide additional details to help classify what each category represents.

input.name: model
input.label: Model
input.hint: Select the desired model from the picklist. If left blank, defaults to gpt-4o .

input.name: temperature
input.label: Temperature
input.hint: Enter a value between 0 and 2 for controlling the randomness of chat completions. Higher values will make the output more random, while lower values will make it more focused and deterministic. If lef…

actions.name: chat_completion
actions.title: Send messages to OpenAI models
actions.help: This action sends a message to ChatGPT, and gathers a response using OpenAI Models. It defaults to gpt-4o . Learn more

input.name: message_type
input.label: Message type
input.hint: Choose the type of the message to send.

actions.name: draft_email
actions.title: Draft email
actions.help: This action generates an email and parses input into datapills containing a subject line and body for easy mapping into future recipe actions. Note that the body contains placeholder text for a salutation if this information isn't present in the email description.

input.name: text
input.label: Email Description
input.hint: Enter a description for the email

input.name: model
input.label: Model
input.hint: Select the desired model from the picklist. If left blank, defaults to gpt-4o .

It uses deep neural networks to learn the patterns in large amounts of text data and generates vector representations that capture the meaning and context of the text. These vectors can be used for a variety of natural la…

input.name: input
input.label: Input
input.hint: Enter the text to obtain an embedded mapping. Input must not exceed 8192 tokens (approximately 6000 words).

input.name: input_list
input.label: Input

properties.name: text
properties.label: Text
properties.hint: Input text must not exceed 8192 tokens (approximately 6000 words).

input.name: model

input.label: User
input.hint: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to monitor and detect abuse.

actions.name: images

actions.help: This action generates an image using a prompt and/or image provided by the user. Learn more

input.name: object

actions.name: moderations

actions.help: This action checks if inputted text violates OpenAI's content policy. Learn more

input.label: Input

input.name: model

actions.name: transcription
actions.title: Transcribe recording
actions.help: This action transcribes an audio file into the language used in the recording. The maximum file size supported is 25 MB. Learn more

input.name: file_content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Provide the file contents to transcribe.

input.name: file_type
input.label: File type
input.hint: Select the file type of the input audio. Supported formats: mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, webm .

input.name: prompt
input.label: Prompt
input.hint: An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The prompt should match the audio language and has to be UTF-8 compatible.

input.name: temperature
input.label: Temperature
input.hint: Enter a value between 0 and 1 for controlling the randomness of transcription. Higher values will make the output more random, while lower values will make it more focused and deterministic. Defaults …

input.name: language
input.label: Language
input.hint: Select the language of the input audio. Only 50 languages are listed in the picklist. Use text field to input other languages. If left blank, defaults to English .

actions.description: Translate text into a different language using OpenAI
actions.help: This action translates inputted text into a different language. While other languages may be possible, languages not on the predefined list may not provide reliable translations.

input.label: Output language
input.hint: Select the desired output language

input.hint: Select the source language. If this value is left blank, we will automatically attempt to identify it.

input.hint: Enter the text to be translated.
